notes.title: Play the Steam Next Fest demo!
notes.content:
Join us in the gardens of Eden and celebrate Steam Next Fest in style!

A free demo is now available for PixelJunk Eden 2 and we invite you to explore the sights and sounds of our psychedelic platformer during Next Fest. Cultivate new plants, collect pollen and help seeds to sprout new exotic leaves as you journey to collect 'Spectra' - the source of all life in the biomes of Eden. Go it alone or adventure together with a friend locally in this brand new demo.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44333574/e7c3126d29c6c17b18b5e13e63e5c901c921162b.png

For players who are new to the PixelJunk Eden series, the demo includes a tutorial that will help you to swing into your first garden with ease.

Join the adventure during Next Fest to explore two unique gardens, available for the first time in full 4K. This stunning demo experience will be available from October 10th until the conclusion of Steam Next Fest on October 16th. 

Please consider adding us to your wishlist and we look forward to your feedback on the demo!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1456570/PixelJunk_Eden_2/

Many thanks and we hope you enjoy playing.

Q-Games
